intent.job_to_be_done: Windows 电脑存储清理：只读扫描产出 Tier 0-3 分级报告，按批准范围清理可再生缓存与安全垃圾，系统级操作逐项确认，产出前后对比账单。
target_users: 需要 C 盘空间急救的开发者
inputs: 清理意图（C盘满/空间不足/清理垃圾）
可选的模块范围或 Tier 范围
对 Tier 2 项的逐项批准
outputs: 清理账单（逐模块释放量、跳过项、失败清单、前后空闲空间）
exclusions: 按文件名模式批量删除

evidence_boundary.lexical_trigger_smoke: 19/19 passed (v1.0.0, re-verified v1.1.0/v1.2.0); not provider-backed routing evidence
evidence_boundary.safety_claims: allowlist design follows audited prior art (clean-my-disk tier system); no independent red-team verification
evidence_boundary.space_gain_numbers: self-reported tutorial estimates, not independently verified; live run on owner machine reclaimed ~19.9 GB (2026-09-14)
evidence_boundary.bundled_publish_dry_run: blocked on Windows host (npx subprocess WinError 2); publish gates executed manually with equivalent evidence
